subject: [PATCH RFC nfs-utils v2 08/10] nfsdctl: fix heap overflow in autostart_func() listener cleanup

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch fixes a heap overflow bug in the autostart_func() function of the nfsdctl utility. The bug occurs when cleaning up listeners after one or more fail to start, causing the program to write beyond the bounds of a dynamically allocated array. To fix this, the code now sizes the array based on the number of threads specified in the /etc/nfs.conf file, rather than setting it to 0 when cleanup is necessary. Additionally, a separate bug that caused memory leaks due to an incorrect return statement has been fixed.
